The '''Salient system''' was a [[star system]] on the edge of the [[Corporate Sector]] of [[the galaxy]]. Its [[Salient's red dwarf|red dwarf]] held several planets in orbit, three of which—[[Salient I]], [[Salient II]], and [[Epiphany]]—were in its habitable zone.<ref name="Catalyst" /> It was situated along the [[Hydian Way]].<ref name="Galaxy Map" />

During the [[Clone Wars]], the Salient system was neutral but leaned towards the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Corporations like [[Zerpen Industries]] took the opportunity to supply weapons to both the [[Galactic Republic]] and the Confederacy. After the war's end, the [[Proclamation of the New Order|newly formed]] [[Galactic Empire]] moved to assert its control over Salient. The [[Salient Campaign|ensuing conflict]] drew [[Mercenary|mercenaries]] from across the galaxy to fight the Empire, including [[Onderonian]] freedom fighter [[Saw Gerrera]]. However, the Empire ultimately defeated the rebels and took control of the system.<ref name="Catalyst" />

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The reference book ''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' erroneously places the Salient system in the [[Western Reaches]], contradicting its stated location in the Corporate Sector.<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref> The galactic map of ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'', on the other hand, places Salient near the edge of (though not inside) the Corporate Sector. This may suggest that the Empire separated Salient from the rest of the Corporate Sector after the events of ''[[Catalyst: A Rogue One Novel]]''.<ref name="Galaxy Map" /><ref name="Catalyst" />
